name: voice-agents-07-nextjs-frontend
//: Node project (no pyproject here). Run `npm install` once, then `npm run dev`. This app needs module 06 (the FastAPI backend) running so it can hand the browser a short-lived ek_ token. See README.md. We pin Next.js to the stable 15.x line (< 16): the tutorial and the App Router layout are written against Next 15, and Next 16 changed its default build toolchain. Bump deliberately later with `npm install next@latest` and re-test.
